k01-left-bakery.observed_description: A man in a navy T-shirt, seen from behind at a crossroads, points his left arm along the left side street; the bakery with bread in its window is on the left corner, a grey office block on the right.
k01-left-bakery.note: Usable: turn left at the bakery reads at 180 px; no writing.

k02-right-bakery.observed_description: The same man from behind points his right arm along the right side street; the bakery with bread in its window is on the right corner, a grey office block on the left.
k02-right-bakery.note: Usable: turn right at the bakery reads at 180 px; no writing.

k03-left-books.observed_description: A woman with long dark wavy hair in a sage-green overshirt, seen from behind, points her left arm along the left side street; a bookstore window full of books is on the left corner.
k03-left-books.note: Usable: turn left at the bookstore reads at 180 px.

k04-right-police.observed_description: The same woman from behind points her right arm along the right side street; a red-brick police station with a white police car (the word POLICE on its door) is on the right corner.
k04-right-police.note: Usable: turn right at the police station reads at 180 px; the one word POLICE names the place its sentence names.
